source_policy: Fixed reviewed bank, retrieved once before all methods and rounds; no benchmark text/SI/answers
rag_control: Sources plus all graph facts flattened; KG receives exactly the same facts as nodes/edges

evaluation.primary: Mean of per-seed final-combination MAE reductions relative to matching-seed D0; all ten trajectories per method
evaluation.input_representation_note: Training-feature-only affine/sign canonicalization of added columns; scientific formulas unchanged; original D0 and ANN fit unchanged; no best sign or seed selection

prerequisites: All 54 faithful historical blocks completed; prefix/final replay tolerance 1e-6 R; equivalent representation audit completed
duplicate_policy: Append finite nonconstant duplicate without resampling; record syntax and affine duplicate flags
technical_failure_policy: At most one equivalence-preserving repair; failed slot skipped, next round continues; no fresh hypothesis
scientific_consistency_policy: Flags are reported separately from numeric execution; absent graph edge is unknown, not disproof
